title: Light and Materials
seo_title: Grade 1 Light and Materials Worksheets: Transparent, Translucent, Opaque and Reflective
standard_text: Plan and conduct investigations to determine the effect of placing objects made with different materials in the path of a beam of light.
meta_desc: Free grade 1 science worksheets on light and materials (NGSS 1-PS4-3): what happens when light hits glass, wax paper, cardboard and mirrors, and how shadows form. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Clear things let light through. Others block it or bounce it.
body_html:
How to think about it

Shine a light. What happens?

  • Clear: all light goes through.
  • Wax paper: some light goes through.
  • Cardboard: blocks light. Mirror: bounces light.
Example

Light hits clear plastic wrap. What happens?

It is clear.

Answer: It goes through.

Example

Light hits cardboard. What is on the wall?

Cardboard blocks light.

Answer: a dark shadow

Common mistakes

  • Thinking clear glass makes a dark shadow.
  • Thinking a mirror lets light through. It bounces light.
  • Thinking wax paper blocks all light. It lets some through.

faq.q: What are transparent, translucent and opaque?
faq.a: Transparent things let all light through, translucent things let some through, and opaque things block it.
A mirror is reflective. It bounces light back.
Shine a flashlight at each material and look at the wall behind it: bright, dim or a dark shadow.
